name: pitch
title: Pitch / proposal
description: Pitch or proposal deck: problem, solution, market, traction, model, competition, team, financials and the ask.
storyline: Problem, then why now, then the solution and proof it works; end on a specific ask. Each slide makes one claim the next slide builds on.

slots.title: <Why now>
slots.guidance: The change (technology, regulation, behaviour) that makes this possible now.

slots.title: <The problem, stated as the customer feels it>
slots.guidance: Who has the problem, how often, what it costs them; one number.

slots.title: <How we solve it, in one sentence>
slots.guidance: What it does and the outcome for the customer; no feature list.

slots.title: <How big the opportunity is>
slots.guidance: 2-3 metrics such as total, serviceable and obtainable market, with sources.

slots.title: <How it works in three steps>
slots.guidance: A 3-5 step process or a product picture.

slots.title: <Proof that it is working>
slots.guidance: Growth in users/revenue/pilots over time; source and period.

slots.title: <How it makes money>
slots.guidance: Pricing and revenue streams as 2-4 boxes.

slots.title: <Why we win against the alternatives>
slots.guidance: Alternatives as columns, 3-5 criteria as rows.

slots.title: <Why this team will deliver>
slots.guidance: 2-4 people with one relevant credential each.

slots.title: <Where the plan gets in 3 years>
slots.guidance: Revenue and cost (or margin) by year; label projections as such.

slots.title: <What we are asking for and what it buys>
slots.guidance: The amount or decision, what it funds, and the milestone it reaches.
